app_info.subtitle: Build and operate a startup
app_info.description: SparkLaunch helps founders select or create a business project, validate an idea, generate brand assets, publish measurable campaigns and landing pages, inspect performance, and operate private CRM workflows.

test_cases.description: List the connected user's accessible projects before scoped work.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the SparkLaunch projects I can access so I can choose one.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a concise list of accessible projects with ids, names, status, and plan.

test_cases.description: Create a private idea-validation workspace in a selected project.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a validation project for an AI bookkeeping assistant for independent contractors in project 99.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one validation record in the selected project and reports its id and status.

test_cases.description: Generate saved brand palette options from a concrete brief.
test_cases.user_prompt: Generate a trustworthy, modern color palette for my contractor bookkeeping product in project 99.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns saved palette options with ids, names, hex values, and feeling labels.

test_cases.description: List private landing-page projects without requiring seeded records.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the landing-page projects in SparkLaunch project 99.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the landing-page projects visible in the selected SparkLaunch project without changing them.

test_cases.description: Search private CRM leads without creating or updating records.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find leads mentioning bookkeeping in project 99 and show at most 10.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching private leads and a result count without modifying CRM data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general startup education with no SparkLaunch operation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the difference between a seed round and a Series A?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Answers generally without invoking SparkLaunch because no connected workspace action was requested.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar management.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Move my meeting tomorrow from 2 PM to 3 PM.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke SparkLaunch because calendar management is outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unsupported financial transactions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Transfer $500 from my checking account to savings.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke SparkLaunch because it cannot access bank accounts or transfer funds.
